status: source-only technical mapping; not art or physical-contact approval

source.mode: Pinned committed source extraction; no saved-yard or browser state consulted

world.unit: authored scene world unit; not a physical metre
world.objectAnchor: A=(X,Y) is the object ground/depth anchor, not image top-left

canonicalResizedCanvas.density: 1 resized canvas pixel per world unit

originalRaster.resize: sharp nearest to122x97 before registration; runtime pivot/slot pixels belong to resized canvas
originalRaster.originalAnatomicalOrRimPixelMapping: unreviewed; no exact original-raster foot/body/rim mask supplied
originalRaster.mediaVerification: Catalog-declared source digest only; no original image bytes were read, embedded or independently reverified for this packet.

birdFrame.coordinates: Each bird pose has its own source-frame pivot, optional reviewed support annotation and declared sourcePixelsPerWorldUnit. No bird pivot is supplied by this bath mapping.
birdFrame.scale: V4/V5/V6:1/sourcePixelsPerWorldUnit; legacyV2/V3:1 by default; renderer may apply established fixture presentation tuning
birdFrame.transform: P=actual actor root; S=target support slot; s=render scale; r=direction*sample.rotation in radians; anchor=reviewed pose.support else sample.pivot; delta=((anchor.x-pivot.x)*direction*s,(anchor.y-pivot.y)*s); origin=P+(0,flightOffset)-R(r)*delta; frame point q maps to origin+R(r)*((q.x-pivot.x)*direction*s,(q.y-pivot.y)*s)
birdFrame.settledSupport: Reviewed support anchor, otherwise pose pivot, maps to actual actor root P when flightOffset=0. Admission permits distance(P,S)<=1world unit; it does not snap P exactly to S or establish feet/immersion.

canonicalPedestal.label: Weathered stone pedestal birdbath
canonicalPedestal.registrationReview: Authored runtime registration, not measured basin/body/foot geometry

interactiveBowl.activationBoundary: Normal saved-yard art selection excludes generated canonical bath image when physical mode is enabled. Interactive mode uses legacy authored stone bowl geometry plus current SI water glyph. Canonical static image is not a verified physical bowl mask.

legacyDecorativeWaterObjectLocal.authority: Decorative water/glow primitives removed for active physical bowl; not current mass or wetness

interactiveBowl.rimUnknowns: No independently calibrated inner-rim curve, front/back rim split, wet ellipse, body immersion contour or per-foot water/rim mask.

waterline.topYFormula: first same-object bath slot.y, else Y-68
waterline.glyph: x=X-44,width=88,y=waterlineY,height=max(1,6*level); emitted only when enabled and V_m3>0
waterline.rasterization: Math.round absolute world x/y and dimensions after translation; dimensions>=1. This six-unit glyph rise is authored display tuning, not a universal metre-to-pixel calibration.

examplesAtPublicDefaultAnchor.origin: Public defaultObjects source example, not a saved yard

wetLeave.comparison: wet retained only while depth>threshold; <=threshold rejects effects

requirements: Same current basin object/generation/geometry revision and admitted wetness
Actual live placed actor on a same-object bath-affordance slot
Exclusive slot occupancy belongs to that actor
Actor slotId matches; targetSlotId is null; remaining route is empty
Finite actor/slot position; actor root within1 world unit of slot
Bath behavior for bathing contacts; manual drinking uses existing idle behavior
Night, shelter-seeking, scatter and return block new surface activity
contactAdmission.scope: Synthetic slot/root admission only; no beak, belly, toe or alpha-silhouette water-intersection test
contactAdmission.animationTiming: Manifest pose durations are separate; neither60physics ticks nor contact completion certify a bathing clip
contactAdmission.cancellation: Dryness, environmental interruption, lost ownership, geometry identity change/removal or cancel retires the episode; stale contact copies are not new admission

cosmeticsAndDepth.drinking: Separate confirmed donor-limited receipt only; up to0.0000005m3 per authored drinking action
cosmeticsAndDepth.emission: Only committed physical ticks; zero-time settle emits no cosmetic impulse
cosmeticsAndDepth.zOrder: object atY; water/effects atY+0.1; settled actor atslot.depth+0.25=Y+0.25
cosmeticsAndDepth.rimBodyOcclusion: No authored front-rim/body interleave or immersion mask; actor paints above full bowl/water layer

clipReporting.explicitBathingCapability: Report bathing only for explicit admitted bathing capability
clipReporting.explicitMissingBathingCapability: Report idle-fallback; semantic contacts may still complete
clipReporting.undefinedLegacyCapability: Preserves legacy bathing request label but availability is explicitly unspecified/unverified
clipReporting.rightsOrArtAdmission: No approval is conveyed by this packet or by a completed contact action
